purpose: 藥對 as first-class records rather than a flat list hanging off one herb. A pair belongs to BOTH herbs, carries its own meaning (why these two), and is the unit formulas are actually built and taught from - so the real chain is 方劑 -> 藥對 -> 單味藥, navigable in every direction.

schema_note.relation: id from data/config/herb_pair_relations.json (七情配伍) - this is what makes it a 藥對 and not just two names
schema_note.pair_meaning: what the pair achieves that neither herb achieves alone - the actual teaching content
schema_note.found_in_formulas: formula ids where this pair does the work, so the formula card can show its pairs

pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 兩藥皆能發汗解表。麻黃開腠理、發汗力峻，桂枝解肌發表、溫通經脈助營衛之氣外達。相須為用，發汗解表之力大增，為風寒表實無汗的核心組合。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Both release the exterior. Ma Huang forcefully opens the pores; Gui Zhi releases the muscle layer and warms the channels, carrying ying and wei outward. Used together they mutually accentuate, and the diaphoretic effect increases markedly - the core combination for Wind-Cold excess with no sweating.
pairs.indication_zh: 風寒表實證：惡寒發熱、無汗、頭身疼痛、脈浮緊
pairs.indication_en: Wind-Cold excess pattern: chills and fever, absence of sweating, headache and body aches, tight floating pulse
pairs.caution_zh: 發汗力強，表虛自汗、陰虛、體弱者不宜；不可過汗。
pairs.caution_en: Strongly diaphoretic - unsuitable for exterior deficiency with spontaneous sweating, yin deficiency, or debility. Do not over-sweat.

pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 麻黃宣發肺氣以開，杏仁肅降肺氣以降。一宣一降，恢復肺的宣降之常，止咳平喘之力遠勝單用。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ma Huang disseminates and opens Lung qi; Xing Ren directs Lung qi downward. One ascends and one descends, restoring the Lung's normal diffusing-and-descending function - far more effective for cough and wheezing than either alone.
pairs.indication_zh: 肺氣壅遏之咳嗽氣喘，無論寒熱皆可隨證配伍
pairs.indication_en: Cough and wheezing from obstructed Lung qi; adaptable to either cold or heat patterns with appropriate partners
pairs.caution_zh: 杏仁有小毒，用量宜慎；嬰幼兒尤須注意。
pairs.caution_en: Xing Ren is slightly toxic; dose carefully, especially in infants and young children.

pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 麻黃辛溫宣肺平喘，石膏辛甘大寒清瀉肺熱。石膏制麻黃之溫燥而存其宣肺之用，使全方由治寒轉為治熱。石膏用量常倍於麻黃，此比例即決定方向。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ma Huang is acrid-warm and disseminates Lung qi to calm wheezing; Shi Gao is acrid-sweet and very cold, draining Lung heat. Shi Gao restrains Ma Huang's warmth and dryness while preserving its diffusing action, turning the formula from cold-treating to heat-treating. Shi Gao is typically dosed at several times Ma Huang, and that ratio is what sets the direction.
pairs.indication_zh: 肺熱壅盛之咳喘：發熱、汗出而喘、口渴、苔黃
pairs.indication_en: Lung heat with cough and wheezing: fever, sweating with wheezing, thirst, yellow coating
pairs.caution_zh: 石膏大寒，脾胃虛寒者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Shi Gao is very cold; use with caution in spleen-stomach deficiency cold.
pairs.teaching_note_zh: 與「麻黃配桂枝」對比記憶：同一味麻黃，配桂枝則治寒，配石膏則治熱——配伍決定方向，這是理解方劑的關鍵範例。
pairs.teaching_note_en: Contrast with Ma Huang + Gui Zhi: the same Ma Huang treats cold when paired with Gui Zhi and heat when paired with Shi Gao. The partner sets the direction - a key example for understanding formula construction.

pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 生薑能減輕半夏之毒性與刺激性（半夏畏生薑、生薑殺半夏毒），同時兩藥皆能降逆止嘔，配伍後既安全又增效。此為相畏／相殺關係最經典的示範。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Sheng Jiang reduces Ban Xia's toxicity and irritancy - the textbook example of mutual counteraction and suppression - while both herbs direct rebellious qi downward and stop vomiting, so the pair is both safer and stronger.
pairs.indication_en: Vomiting from phlegm-fluid retention; rebellious stomach qi
pairs.caution_zh: 生半夏毒性大，內服須用製半夏。
pairs.caution_en: Raw Ban Xia is markedly toxic; only processed Ban Xia is taken internally.
